notes.title: Making great progress!
notes.notes:
Hello! We wanted to give a quick update on the great progress we made over the last two weeks. The release date is getting closer and closer. We are already so excited!

[b]8 maps are fully ready now (except a little bit polishing).[/b]
There are a lot of special mechanics like moving lily pads with a damage buff to place your plants on. Or weed you can grow on parts of the path to block enemies. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42796732/b5888f769948b11ee0525172f96e5dfcf9762697.png[/img]

[b]We developed a full system with achievements and unlockable stuff.[/b] You are able to unlock all plants while progressing through the maps. Every map has main achievements (which aren't easy). These achievements will be part of the Steam achievements which you will be able to unlock on your Steam profile.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42796732/f9ac5213a1febfb6746646baff091291283ea43a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42796732/695ef89413d74519d364b950503aeaed2f6e3b9c.png[/img]

[b]A lot of statistics viewable ingame.[/b]
You will be able to track a lot of statistics about your game performance. A lot of these statistics will be used for Steam Achievements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42796732/b8744c9f5e9d06c9b418931de575eeb1b27459c8.png[/img]


[h2]Next steps:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Create models for snails and use them as enemies (Will replace the round eyes we currently have as enemies
[*] Create better textures for the ground on maps
[*] Steam Achievements
[*] Steam Leaderboard
[*] Improve the UI
[*] Improve some of the sounds
[/list]

notes.title: New maps and mechanics
notes.notes:
I wanted to give a small update on what happened and on what I'm working since I created the Steam store page.

[h2]New maps[/h2]

My main priority is creating many new maps. As many prototypes as possible. The best and most fun maps will be finished with full designs. Here are prototypes I created so far:


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42796732/f8c2daeca44f7cf6e9901742b3fc00064e817a09.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42796732/02cb0f878cd74345ff8a1c7ef3ba1ee0d19e1e44.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42796732/0b5d779201f0f33c9737eb594b3d4e8513b7c0f4.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42796732/927cca37ad14cc4817a22b8a9bb0a6852a588438.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42796732/3040b07c31c553a11d1226f22677daf2452c5be8.png[/img]


[h2]New mechanics[/h2]

There are two new mechanics which can be seen on map 4 and 5.

[b]Teleporters[/b]

The white fields are teleporter which warps enemies to another point on the map.

[b]Obstacles[/b]

On certain fields there is small weed on the path. Spend some currency and grow them big to block the path for enemies. This could give you a tactical advantage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42796732/0f65a9ff99d6871d61590e836b3d188bcbdcbd31.gif[/img]

[h2]More updates[/h2]

There is still a lot to do until the full release and it's working great so far. I'm able to develope a lot of stuff really fast. A lot of foundation stone is already set.

[b]Ideas for buildings[/b]

Currently there are 7 different buildings. There will be at least 15 for the release. One building is buffing all buildings next to it. Another building will be dublicating itself over time to free fields around itself. That's just two examples.

[b]More enemy types[/b]

[b]Powerup fields for enemies[/b]
